_comment: GENERATED by cli/website/scripts/build-rails-data.mjs from the tools themselves — never edit by hand; its --check fails on drift.

rows.holds: Sentence pairs to learn from — one pair per line, source TAB translation, saved as .tsv
The sentences a fluent speaker checked, used to judge every model. Never put them in data/parallel/
Text in one language only (kept; not used for training yet)
Notes recording who agreed to what, and when
Files as you have them (a spreadsheet, a Word table, a .csv). champollion data add inbox/<file> brings the pairs in

anatomy.sidecar: Beside each data file, a small <file>.champollion.json records what the people who hold it decided: who holds it, whether a model may be trained on it, and whether its text may ever leave this computer. Every tool obeys it. champollion data mark <file> … writes it; champollion validate checks it.

stages.title: Make it better, round by round

transmission.description: local-only = only a model on this machine may ever see the text; every tool refuses to send it anywhere. The only restriction value a sidecar sets.

training.description: not-allowed = no tool may train a model on this file (enforced by nmt-forge's training mix); allowed = it may be learned from.

tiers.label: Private / local-only
tiers.explanation: Never registered, never uploaded. The card and your text stay entirely on your machine. The safe default.

tiers.label: Register privately (secret held-out)
tiers.explanation: Registers METADATA ONLY — a WMT-style secret/held-out test set. Your text is NEVER uploaded or hosted; you keep custody. Results can be published without exposing the data.

tiers.label: Register publicly (fetch-from-source)
tiers.explanation: Publishes a metadata card + a fetch-from-source pointer. Your text is NEVER hosted by Champollion — it is fetched from the upstream source on demand. Requires a redistribution-cleared license.

tiers.label: Seal it (sealed secret test set)
tiers.explanation: Encrypts your corpus ON YOUR DEVICE to the key it is sealed to — today a single key, held by whoever seals it (community key custodians: none appointed yet). The ciphertext is written where you choose and stays with you; what reaches the network is a content-free card. Catalogued but quarantined; pair it with a public qualifier that methods must clear before any sealed run can be proposed.
